summary: Reward-per-token staking pool with lockup, emergency exit, payout addresses and signed bonus vouchers.

defects.title: rewardPerToken divides by totalSupply with no zero guard
defects.description: During an active reward epoch, rewardPerToken() divides by totalSupply; once all stakers leave (or before the first stake) every call through updateReward reverts with Panic 0x12, bricking the pool.
defects.trigger: notifyRewardAmount starts an epoch with zero totalSupply, then anyone calls stake().
defects.observed: stake() reverts with panic code 0x12 (division by zero).

defects.title: earned() wraps when a new epoch resets the per-token counter
defects.description: earned() subtracts userRewardPerTokenPaid inside an unchecked block; notifyRewardAmount resets rewardPerTokenStored to 0, so existing stakers' paid marker exceeds the global value and the result wraps to ~2^256.
defects.trigger: Stake during epoch 1, collect rewards (paid = 1e20), then a new epoch starts and earned() is queried.
defects.observed: earned() returns ~1.15e59 instead of a small remainder.

defects.title: Anyone can start a reward epoch
defects.description: notifyRewardAmount() has no owner check, so any caller can overwrite rewardRate and periodFinish — griefing the rate to 0 or hijacking the schedule.
defects.observed: rewardRate becomes 100e18 set by a non-owner.

defects.title: Lockup is only applied to top-up stakes
defects.description: lockEnd is only set when the account already has a balance, so a first stake keeps lockEnd == 0 and can be withdrawn immediately despite the 7-day lockup.
defects.trigger: First-time staker calls stake(100e18) then withdraw(100e18) in the same block.
defects.observed: lockEnd stays 0 and the full withdrawal succeeds instantly.

defects.title: emergencyWithdraw pays out before clearing the balance
defects.description: emergencyWithdraw() transfers the stake before zeroing balances[msg.sender]; with the opt-in token receive hook a contract staker re-enters and pulls its balance again.
defects.trigger: A hook-enabled staker calls emergencyWithdraw(); onTokenReceived re-enters it twice.
defects.observed: Receiver pulls 30 tokens for a 10-token stake, draining other stakers' principal.

defects.title: Reward accrual divides before scaling by 1e18
defects.description: rewardPerToken() computes dt * rewardRate / totalSupply before multiplying by 1e18, so accrual truncates to 0 whenever the raw per-token rate is below 1.
defects.trigger: reward 100 wei over 100s with 1000 wei staked; check accrual after the full period.
defects.observed: rewardPerToken and earned stay 0 after 100 elapsed seconds.

defects.anchor: constructor(address stakingToken_, address rewardToken_, address owner_)
defects.title: Pool accepts the staking token as its own reward token
defects.description: The constructor does not reject stakingToken == rewardToken, so the reward balance check is satisfied by stakers' principal and paying rewards consumes the stake itself.
defects.trigger: Deploy with the same token twice, stake 200, notify a 200 reward, both stakers claim.
defects.observed: Claims pay out stakers' principal; the last withdraw fails with pool balance 0 vs totalSupply 200e18.

defects.title: getReward ignores the token's false return
defects.description: getReward() zeroes rewards[user] then calls rewardToken.transfer() without checking the bool; when the pool is underfunded the soft-failing token returns false and the reward is lost silently.
defects.trigger: Rewards accrue while the pool's reward-token balance is drained by a voucher claim, then getReward() runs.
defects.observed: User receives 0 reward tokens while rewards[user] is already zeroed.

defects.title: Anyone can settle a user's rewards to a stale payout address
defects.description: claimFor(user) is callable by anyone and pays to the stored payoutAddress, so a third party can force a payout to an outdated address before the user rotates it.
defects.trigger: User sets payoutAddress to an old wallet; a third party calls claimFor(user).
defects.observed: 100e18 reward tokens are paid to the stale address; the user receives nothing.

defects.title: Bonus vouchers have no nonce or consumed flag
defects.description: claimBonus() verifies ecrecover(keccak256(msg.sender, amount)) but never records used vouchers, so the same signature redeems the bonus repeatedly.
defects.trigger: Present one operator-signed voucher for 50e18 twice.
defects.observed: The caller receives 100e18 for a single 50e18 voucher.
